Version %1$s:
  • Added an option to remember your Home reading position across refreshes and app launches, including your last selected tab.
  • Added image paste and drag-and-drop when composing posts.
  • Improved RSS reading with opening-mode recommendations and feed-content fallback when webpage loading fails.
  • Improved predictive-back animations and page corners in split-screen and windowed modes.
  • Fixed post character counts, media saving, and reaction-list crashes, with performance improvements.
